verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken leaderboard layout. 'Sore throat' and 'Headache' are merged onto one line, so the list shows 5 items under a '6 SYMPTOMS' headline. The list text is tiny (about 10px). The headline wraps badly, leaving a small '6' above a large 'SYMPTOMS', and 'SYMPTOMS' butts against the symptom list. The sparkle and the cropped doctor figure crowd into the middle. B also jams the #FLATTENTHECURVE badge against the '6', so it has slightly worse spacing than A, which leaves a bit more room around the badge.
